title: Newmark Arranges $130 Million Sale of NorthBay Health Collection in Solano County, California
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $130 million sale of the 222,073-square-foot NorthBay Health Medical Outpatient Building (“MOB”) Collection, compromised of six fully leased healthcare assets.
body_markdown: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $130 million sale of the 222,073-square-foot NorthBay Health Medical Outpatient Building (“MOB”) Collection, compromised of six fully leased healthcare assets.
